name: lane
description: One git worktree per task, so tasks in one repo can run side by side
author: Van Nguyen (https://github.com/vannt-dev)

scripts.diagrams: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@latest -i docs/diagrams/overview.mmd -c docs/diagrams/mermaid.config.json -b transparent -t default -o docs/diagrams/overview-light.svg && npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@latest -i docs/diagrams/overview.mmd -c docs/diagrams/mermaid.config.json -b transparent -t dark -o docs/diagrams/overview-dark.svg
